turns.text: There's when our main supplier went bust and I found a new one in three days.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pick based on the job. For a team lead role, the month of training new starters is strongest. For anything with numbers, the billing mistake. Keep the angry customer as a backup for a question about difficult people.
